title: Sensitivity-Constrained Neural Operators for Data-Efficient Forward and Inverse Modeling of Partial Differential Equation Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.29888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators provide fast surrogates for partial differential equation (PDE) solvers, but their reliability can degrade for high-dimensional spatial inputs and inverse or repeated inference. State-only training constrains solution values but not the learned input--output response. We study sensitivity-constrained neural operators (SC-NOs), which augment standard training with sampled solver-derived Jacobian supervision. Selected sensitivities from differentiable solvers or discrete adjoints are matched during training, allowing response information to be amortized across minibatches without imposing the full Jacobian at every update. We evaluate SC-NO on advection--diffusion and RANS--Spalart--Allmaras benchmarks, input-dimensionality scaling tests, long-horizon autoregressive rollout, and a shallow-water Tohoku tsunami source-inversion case. Sensitivity supervision improves forward prediction and yields larger gains in gradient-base

translated_title: 敏感度约束神经算子：面向偏微分方程系统的数据高效正向与逆向建模
translated_abstract: 神经算子为偏微分方程（PDE）求解器提供了快速代理模型，但其可靠性在高维空间输入以及逆向或重复推理场景中可能下降。仅基于状态的训练只能约束解的数值，却无法约束学习到的输入—输出响应。我们研究了敏感度约束神经算子（SC-NOs），它在标准训练的基础上引入了通过采样获得的、由求解器导出的雅可比矩阵监督。训练过程中匹配来自可微求解器或离散伴随方法的选定敏感度，使响应信息能够在各小批量之间摊销，而无需在每次更新时施加完整的雅可比矩阵。我们在平流—扩散和RANS—Spalart—Allmaras基准问题、输入维度缩放测试、长时间自回归滚动预测，以及浅水方程东日本（Tohoku）海啸震源反演案例上对SC-NO进行了评估。敏感度监督改善了正向预测，并在基于梯度的逆向推理中带来了更大的收益。
tldr: 提出敏感度约束神经算子（SC-NO），通过在训练中引入可微求解器或离散伴随方法导出的采样雅可比监督，以数据高效的方式提升PDE系统正向预测与逆向建模的可靠性和精度。
en_tdlr: Proposes sensitivity-constrained neural operators (SC-NOs) that augment standard training with sampled solver-derived Jacobian supervision, enabling data-efficient and reliable forward and inverse modeling of PDE systems.
